text_block_list.text:
When I searched for Ace, who hadn't shown 
up for training, I found her standing 
motionless in the rain under an overpass.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... How strange. It feels like all 
the noise is melting away...
choice_data_list: So this is where you were.
So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Oh, Trainer. Come on over, you too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Nice place, isn't it? The hustle and 
bustle of the city is washed away by the 
sound of the rain... Here is the only 
place that sounds just like my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Being like this... all the tiredness from 
training... just fades—...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! Seriously!!! Ugh, what in the 
world am I doing...?!

She seemed truly remorseful, so I let her 
off with just a light warning this time.
